title: abutilon abutiloides
intro: Abutilon abutiloides, commonly known as the Indian mallow, is a plant species in the Malvaceae family. It is a flowering plant native to India and Southeast Asia, known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Abutilon abutiloides include its use in treating fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
